title: Buried Beneath the Boardwalk: Neptune Ghouls and Ghost Tours
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Dive into the spine-chilling history of Virginia Beach with our ghostly walking tour, designed to thrill and educate!

Guided by a local haunt expert, this mile-long journey takes you through haunted landmarks like the majestic King Neptune Statue and the eerie Conch Shell Art Installation. As twilight descends, hear chilling tales of murderous sirens, relentless pirates, and restless witches, each story echoing through these haunted grounds.

Feel the thrill as you stand near the boardwalk where Blackbeard’s ship, Queen Anne’s Revenge, once prowled, or gaze at the haunting Norwegian Lady Statue. The after-hours setting adds a chilling atmosphere, intensifying the ghostly legends that linger in the air. 

Though we can’t enter private buildings, the atmosphere is thick with history and mystery.

Join us for an after-hours adventure and discover why Virginia Beach is a top haunted destination on the East Coast!
